desc:
🎃 HALLOWEEN UPDATE: Haunted Hollow, pumpkin eggs and Halloween tokens!
⭐ ADMIN ABUSE every Saturday at 14:00 UTC: huge boosts and rare eggs falling from the sky!

🥚 Welcome to Steal Eggs Together!
👤 Play SOLO or 👥 team up with a friend!

How to Play:
🥚 Sneak past giant guardians and steal their eggs
🐣 Hatch eggs to collect rare pets
💰 Earn money from your pets, even offline
🏃 Train on your treadmill to get faster
🐉 Ride your pets and race the guardians home
🤝 With a friend: carry GIANT and TITAN eggs together!
🔀 Merge 3 pets into 1 stronger pet
🗺️ 7 worlds and 14 guardians to beat
✨ Find glowing variants, giant sizes and GOD pets!

🎁 Join Limebun Studios for FREE +10,000 Speed!
🎮 Supports Desktop, Mobile and Tablet players
